title: VIXEN worktrees need a local entry point to the required build queue
body: The worker brief requires tools/with-test-lock.sh, but this worktree has no file at that path. Build and test commands had to use the configured external symlink /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh to reach the real Undertow queue. Add or generate a worktree-local forwarding entry point so the mandated queue is discoverable from each lane.

title: The CodegenTool CMake target must cap MSBuild internal workers
body: The queue-wrapped cmake --build build/wsl --target engine_codegen_tool --parallel 8 stalled at 199 seconds with no CPU or output even though CMake assigned the target to a one-slot MSBuild pool. A queued dotnet build of the same project with -m:1 -nodeReuse:false -p:InvariantGlobalization=true completed in 1.18 seconds, and lightingconfig_check passed after the target added -m:1. Make the facade propagate the serial worker limit into MSBuild itself.

title: The CodegenTool dotnet run check path can stall after a successful build
body: After the CodegenTool built successfully, a queue-wrapped dotnet.dll run --project CodegenTool.csproj --configuration Release -m:1 -nodeReuse:false -p:InvariantGlobalization=true -- ... --check produced no output for more than three minutes and was explicitly cancelled (queue wrapper exit 76, payload exit 143). The repository lightingconfig_check target, which runs the built DLL directly, passed. Provide one canonical queued check command that uses the built DLL without re-entering the stalled run/build path.

title: GPU CTest should get the configured Dozen ICD and layer paths automatically
body: The requested 50-case focused suite passed only when launched from VIXEN in a login shell with VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/home/liory/.cache/vixen/wsl-vulkan/dzn_icd.json and VK_LAYER_PATH=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/vixhyg/VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk/1.4.350.1/x86_64/share/vulkan/explicit_layer.d. Put those configure-derived values on the relevant CTest entries or in the supported test wrapper so callers do not need to export them manually.

title: VIXEN lane provisioning should include the CodeGraph index
body: The required codegraph explore query could not run because this worktree has no .codegraph index, and the tool instructed us not to initialize one here. Investigation had to fall back to manual source search. Provision the read-only CodeGraph index when creating VIXEN lane worktrees, or make the supported worker query available without a per-worktree index.
